title: Glad to find this sub! And... My MallWorld:
content: It's pretty common for me to dream with a huge place like a mall or a college and I have to walk through these endless corridors, stairs, and sometimes elevators in order to accomplish some task. The funny thing is that I always know the place and where to go, but at the same time the walk never ends... So it's good to know that I have somewhere to share this. What is interesting to me is that I feel that I know these places for years... Like they are in my routine everyday. My mallworld usually is a actual mall.
